items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Naturally I know him and worked with him... We all came from under Major N. Clark Smith... Major N. Clark Smith, he was really a captain or something in the United States Army and he formed this band... This man that was our musical director at Winter Phillips

ctx.x: But the school that I went to was [Unintelligible] High School, the big school on the south side. If you lived farther out… some guys like Joe Williams I think went to another high school but the majority of black students went to [Unintelligible] High School. TAYLOR; And they had a wonderful music program I understand.

Oh, yeah, Major N. Clark Smith was absolutely… I‟m so very thrilled and happy that now young students are researching Major N. Clark Smith. I‟m getting a lot of letters from kids who are writing their thesis and their masters, their dissertations about
